items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 30 September 2026 10:03pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Wednesday, 30 September 2026 at 10:00pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds later.


##Synopsis##

A deep area of low pressure to the west of Scotland tracks north and fills.


##Wind##

South backing Southwest 4 or 5, increasing Southerly 5 or 6 tomorrow evening.


##State of Sea##

Mainly moderate, falling slight or moderate overnight.


##Weather##

Isolated showers, soon becoming fair.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in any showers.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Southerly 5 or 6, increasing 6 or 7 around midday on Friday, then veering and decreasing West or Northwest 4 or 5 later.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, becoming moderate or rough later.


##Weather##

Rain and showers spread from the west overnight into Friday.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in rain or showers.
